quirks: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint. The body MUST include a `model` field set to `minimax/minimax-m2.7` (BlockRun's slug) — omitting it or using a bare name like `minimax-m2` will not route correctly.
x402 payment on Base; very cheap (~$0.001 per short call). Price scales with token usage (priceDisplay='Varies').
Response includes completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens — this is a reasoning model.
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style JSON body containing `model` set to "minimax/minimax-m2.7" and a `messages` array (e.g. [{"role":"user","content":"..."}]). Pay via x402 USDC on Base; the call is sync and cheap (~$0.001 for a short prompt, scaling with tokens). Read the assistant reply from body.choices[0].message.content and token counts from body.usage.
